title: Night Cream vs Face Oil: Which Is Better for Your Skin at Night?
ex: A night cream adds water and oil; a face oil only adds oil. Which suits your skin type and Indian weather, and how to use both together.
rt: Night Cream vs Face Oil: Which Is Better at Night? | Mirc Glow
rd: Night cream vs face oil: how they differ, which suits oily, dry and combination skin in Indian weather, and how to layer face oil with night cream safely.
quick: A night cream contains water and oils, so it moisturises and helps hold hydration in. A face oil contains only oils, so it softens and seals but adds no water. Most people, especially oily skin in humid weather, do better with a cream. Very dry skin can add a drop of oil on top.
facts: Oil goes after night cream, as the last step

One or two drops of face oil are enough
